subject: general
question: Which of the following is the scheme of interest subsidy on educational loans for overseas studies for students belonging to the minority communities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padho Pardesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padho Pardesh** is the scheme of interest subsidy on educational loans for overseas studies for students belonging to minority communities.
 
• This **initiative was launched by the Ministry of Minority Affairs in 2006.**
 
• The Padho Pardesh scheme** aims to provide interest subsidies** to deserving students from economically weaker sections 
 
 
• including Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis.
 
 
 
• It Provided on the **interest payable for the moratorium period **of the education loan 
 
• **Padho Videsh** is now replaced by** Padho Pardesh**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Naya Savera**

 
 
• It is the **Scholarship scheme** for minority students pursuing higher education.
 
• It Focuses on e**conomically weaker sections.**
 
• It Provides financial assistance for undergraduate, postgraduate, and technical courses.
 
 
 
• **Nai Udaan**
 
 
• It is the** Scholarship scheme** for minority students clearing entrance exams.
 
• It Focuses on students **pursuing higher education in prestigious institutions.**
 
• It Provides financial assistance for coaching, living expenses, and tuition fees.
